itineraries.title: British Airways via Heathrow, Tue 6 Apr -> Thu 8 Apr (lands Fri 03:55)
itineraries.verification: verified; fact-checked 18 Nov 2026 - price re-read at NIS 8,525 (Google booking page, 00:49); UK ETA added as a mandatory extra; BA405+BA830 match Trip.com, BA831+BA404 seen on Google only (routes match FlightAware); not checked on britishairways.com

bags.included: 1 free carry-on and 1st checked bag free per passenger (Google Flights).

notes: Only option found with a checked bag included, and long, relaxed connections (3h30 at LHR on the way out, 3h55 on the way back). Lands Dublin Tue 14:30; leaves Dublin Thu 15:30.

UK ETA REQUIRED (resolved 18 Nov 2026). British Airways states that customers in transit from an international flight to the Republic of Ireland at Heathrow Terminal 5 must clear UK immigration, because those flights depart from the domestic Common Travel Area, and therefore need a UK ETA. gov.uk confirms Israeli passport holders need an ETA to pass through UK border control (GBP 20 each). An ordinary airside international-to-international transit would not need one.
The same round trip appeared at 8,525 and 8,527 in different captures (rounding).

itineraries.title: Cheapest found: self-transfer via Athens out Tue 6 Apr, via Cluj back Thu 8 Apr (lands Fri 08:35)
itineraries.verification: verified per leg; fact-checked 18 Nov 2026 - legs re-read at NIS 1,006 / 977 / 870 / 781 (Google booking pages, 00:50-00:53); Ryanair's fare API gives EUR 90.99 and EUR 80.99 pp and Wizz's timetable API RON 389 pp (each x3 = Google's price); flight number W43311 could not be confirmed outside Google; bag costs corrected (Israir trolley is not free); the combination is self-built

bags.included: Israir: one small personal bag 40x30x20 cm only - a trolley is NOT included (israir.co.il; Google's '1 free carry-on' is this bag). Ryanair Basic: one small under-seat bag 40x30x20 cm only. Wizz Basic: under-seat item only.
bags.trolley_nis: Ryanair 45-129 per passenger per flight (x2 flights); Wizz Priority EUR 13-60 = 46-214 per passenger (wizzair.com fee table); Israir USD 30 = 97 per passenger (USD 40 = 130 at Ben Gurion). All four flights: 233-569 per passenger
bags.checked_nis: Ryanair 77-215 per passenger per flight; Wizz 20 kg EUR 10-125 = 36-446 per flight; Israir first bag 23 kg USD 65 = 211

itineraries.deviation: Cheaper than every single-ticket option, at the cost of four unprotected flights.
itineraries.risk: Self-transfer: separate tickets, no rebooking or compensation if one leg is late, bags re-checked at each stop. The return lands Friday 08:35 (rule OK, 3h25 margin) on the only nonstop Cluj-TLV flight Google lists for that day: if FR9589 or W43311 is cancelled or badly delayed there is no way home before Shabbat. Greece and Romania are Schengen entries (ETIAS is not in operation and has no start date as of 18 Nov 2026 - re-check in March 2027).
notes: Four separate tickets on three airlines. 348 pp cheaper than DUB-01 only with under-seat bags. A cabin trolley on all four flights costs 233-569 pp (Israir 97 + Ryanair 90-258 + Wizz 46-214), i.e. 1,445-1,781 pp - more than DUB-09 (1,395 pp, trolley included) and at most 115 pp less than DUB-01.
Outbound: 2h50 between landing at ATH and the Ryanair departure - you enter Greece (Schengen), collect any bags and re-check. Return: 6h55 overnight in Cluj airport (22:45 -> 05:40).

Kayak sold the same pattern as a 'self-transfer hack' (Aegean 05:00 + Ryanair via ATH out; Ryanair + Wizz via CLJ back) at $423 pp / $1,268 total = 1,373 pp, and this exact Israir 07:45 + Ryanair outbound with the Cluj return at $434 pp = 1,409 pp. Kayak's totals are higher than the sum of the airline-direct prices in the ticket table.

Fact-check 18 Nov 2026: Wizz's own timetable shows Cluj -> Tel Aviv only on Mon 5, Fri 9 and Mon 12 Apr, so a missed Friday 05:40 flight means Monday. The flight number W43311 could not be confirmed outside Google Flights (FlightAware shows W4 3479 on this route today). Ryanair requires non-EU passport holders to complete its travel-document check before airport security - allow for it inside the 2h50 at Athens. Whether Cluj airport stays open to passengers overnight was not checked.

bags.included: Israir: one small personal bag 40x30x20 cm only - a trolley is NOT included (israir.co.il; Google's '1 free carry-on' is this bag). Ryanair Basic: one small under-seat bag 40x30x20 cm only. Wizz Basic: under-seat item only.
bags.trolley_nis: Ryanair 54-155 (LGW-DUB) and 45-129 (DUB-LGW) per passenger; Wizz Priority EUR 13-60 = 46-214 per passenger (wizzair.com fee table); Israir USD 30 = 97 per passenger (USD 40 = 130 at Ben Gurion). All four flights: 242-595 per passenger
bags.checked_nis: Ryanair 77-257 per passenger per flight; Wizz 20 kg EUR 10-125 = 36-446 per flight; Israir first bag 23 kg USD 65 = 211

itineraries.deviation: Costs about 220 pp more than DUB-01 (before the UK ETA) but replaces two connections with a day in London.
itineraries.risk: Self-transfer: four separate tickets, no protection if a leg is late, bags re-checked. Israeli passports need a UK ETA to enter the UK (gov.uk: GBP 20 each; the checker returns 'ETA or Standard Visitor visa' for Israel). Ireland is outside Schengen and has its own passport control; the UK ETA does not cover it and Ireland is visa-free for Israelis.
notes: Only nonstop flights (5h25, 1h25, 1h30, 5h00). Monday evening and all of Tuesday in London, Wednesday in Dublin, home Thursday 20:50 - no Friday exposure at all.

Needs one hotel night in London (Mon) and a transfer from Luton to central London and on to Gatwick. Cheaper Tuesday alternative from Luton itself: FR331 LTN 19:00 -> DUB 20:20 at 349 for 3 (search-list price).
Thursday: FR306 lands Gatwick 09:20, Wizz leaves 13:50 from the same airport - 4h30 self-transfer through UK border control.
